Nina (CS): FYI Ledgerly onboarding surfaced 4 asks. renewal review in ~5 weeks so this is time-sensitive.

Nina (CS): Items: 1) ability to set per-route embedding TTL shorter for dev/test. 2) monthly CSV of per-route token usage + $cost for finance exports. 3) missing explicit KMS/service-account step in onboarding flow; customers get blocked. 4) console warning when reserved capacity hits 80% so ops can react.

Jordan (PM): can we get quick impact ratings?

Nina (CS): impact: 1) TTL = medium (cost control). 2) CSV export = high (finance-driven). 3) KMS step = high (blocks go-live). 4) capacity warning = medium (ops risk).

Ravi (Eng): quick feasibility: TTL = small (config flag). CSV = small-medium (aggregation + UI). KMS UX = moderate (console + docs + security review). Capacity warning = small.

Jordan (PM): proposed order: P0=KMS onboarding step + docs, P1=CSV export, P2=TTL flag, P2=capacity warning (simple alert first). Agree?

Sam (SE): workaround for CSV: use API + jq to build CSV. Snippet below:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=ledgerly&group_by=route&start=2026-01-01&end=2026-01-31" \n  | jq -r '.routes[] | [.route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > ledgerly-jan-routes.csv
```

Maya (Enablement): I can host a 45m assist session tomorrow 9am PT to walk through KMS steps and patch the onboarding gaps. Can product add checklist text to the modal as a short-term fix?

Jordan (PM): will open a 2-day spike for KMS console changes and tag security. Ravi, can you pick up the spike Monday?

Ravi (Eng): yes will take it. will post findings here.

Nina (CS): I'll tell Ledgerly we have an enablement session + CSV workaround and that product is prioritizing KMS spike. they seemed relieved and will pause renewal convo until after the assist.

triage-bot: please create ticket "onboarding: KMS step + modal checklist" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
